function.arguments: {"message":"During a plan migration your automation rules stay in place and keep running – they’re tied to the workspace, not the plan tier. In Settings → Automation → Rules you’ll see the status of every rule, including any that will be paused. If a rule uses a capability that only exists on the destination tier, it will activate as soon as the migration finishes. If it relies on a capability that the destination tier does not include, the rule is paused (not deleted) and will automatically reactivate if the workspace ever returns to a tier that includes that capability. No re‑configuration is required for your rules, API keys or webhooks. "}

arguments.message: During a plan migration your automation rules stay in place and keep running – they’re tied to the workspace, not the plan tier. In Settings → Automation → Rules you’ll see the status of every rule, including any that will be paused. If a rule uses a capability that only exists on the destination tier, it will activate as soon as the migration finishes. If it relies on a capability that the destination tier does not include, the rule is paused (not deleted) and will automatically reactivate if the workspace ever returns to a tier that includes that capability. No re‑configuration is required for your rules, API keys or webhooks.
